title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: An attacker can bypass login authentication and access the administrator account without knowing the password.
remediation: Use parameterized SQL queries and validate user inputs to prevent SQL injection.

title: SQL Injection in Product Search
impact: An attacker can extract sensitive user information including email addresses and password hashes.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and validate user inputs to prevent SQL injection.

title: XSS in Product Search
impact: The search input executed injected JavaScript in the browser. This demonstrates an XSS risk.
remediation: Use safe DOM rendering and avoid inserting untrusted HTML into the page.

title: Stored XSS in Customer Feedback
impact: If stored feedback is rendered without sanitization, an attacker could execute JavaScript in another user browser.
remediation: Sanitize stored HTML and encode user-generated content before displaying it.
